name: Trypanothione Reductase
notes: FAD is ESSENTIAL: the catalytic site forms on the flavin face, so a receptor prepared without it has a cavity, not a pocket. Grid centred on the trypanothione binding site. Classic, well validated target, absent in mammals (which use glutathione reductase instead). Inhibiting it compromises the parasite's thiol-dependent antioxidant defence, which is why it is the usual entry point for redox-active compounds.
literature: Krauth-Siegel 2003; PDB has FAD + TS2 co-crystal.
references: Krauth-Siegel et al., 2003, Antioxid Redox Signal
